title: BONDING INSTRUCTIONS
summary: General fiberglass body panel bonding rules for the whole car: typical bonded-joint cross sections (Bond A through N, no I) showing where the bonding adhesive bead goes between overlapping, flanged and butt panels. Uses polyester adhesive 56a; squeezed-out bond must be cleaned off where it could reduce chassis clearances, and in visible areas the cured bead is ground flush and sanded. No specific parts.

materials.where: all typical bond sections A-N (bond bead shown solid black)

notes: Bonding adhesive: 56a ADHESIVE POLYESTER 7.25 GALS. PER VEHICLE, as required in the typical sections shown (note A).
Note B: clean off squeezed-out bond wherever it could reduce or eliminate clearance to chassis components (underbody, door sill, closing panels, etc.).
Note C (appearance areas, flagged on Bonds C, E, G, H, N): after the bond cures, grind the excess cement bead flush with the surface and sand smooth.
notes_internal: Drawing-only sheet: 13 typical bond sections labelled A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, J, K, L, M, N (no I); no callouts or part numbers, so no parts/fastening.
